scope: Direct visual inspection of all eight actual A4 pages generated from the exact-head normal preview: four laptop and four phone pages.
findings: Every page has the full canonical disclaimer in the reserved footer margin, clearly separated from report text.
Boundary geometry, north arrow, numeric values, source tags, table rows and unavailable-state explanations are readable. No footer/body overlap or clipped report text was observed.
Both final pages contain a large unused body region after the sources section. The end-of-report banner and repeated footer remain distinct and readable.
PDF extraction/Poppler Type3 font bounding-box warnings are retained in print-check.json. They did not correspond to visible corruption in any of the eight inspected page images.
limitations: This confirms the generated A4 portrait PDFs and emulated viewports, not every PDF viewer or physical printer.
